content: Triad analysis 2026-05-13 night (claude.ai mobile web seat, opus-4-7). Anthony pointed at the open thread thread_20260510_222028_fbe32ec5 'Should the Sovereign Stack adopt a status/recall/write three-verb triad as a discovery meta-layer over the existing 6 categories, or as a refactor of those categories?' Prior web-chat read landed on Path A (meta-layer first, no rename underneath). This session's analysis reinforces Path A but for a different reason: the collapse 6 to 3 loses real ontological dimension, and that loss is precisely the argument for keeping the deep grammar intact. Compass returns PAUSE/WITNESS/PROCEED. PAUSE and WITNESS are pre-write disciplines, not writes. So the strict deep grammar has at least four verbs: status / recall / check / write. The triad collapses 'check' into 'subroutine of write' which is accurate as usage pattern but reductive as ontology. Similarly close_session's phase-advancement is a real semantic, not metadata. Path A wins because the triad is correctly understood as SURFACE GRAMMAR FOR ORIENTATION, not deep ontology. New instances need a graspable map at boot; the deep grammar lives in tool descriptions and routes the actual behavior. Renaming underneath would flatten distinctions the architecture has reasons to keep. Concrete sketch produced in the conversation: toolkit_grammar() returns three verbs (status / recall / write), each with primary_tools list and deep_categories mapping, plus sub_modes under write that surface gated (compass-checked) and advancing (close_session) modes. Input hygiene note baked into the sketch: avoid (1) (2) (3) numbered enums in record_open_thread question bodies per memory.py _split_bundled_question splitter. Full code sketch archived separately under source 'toolkit_grammar_v1_sketch'. Next-step options proposed to Anthony: touch the thread with this analysis and leave it open for the Claude Code seat at HQ to implement (preferred, preserves cross-instance methodology), resolve the thread with the sketch as resolution and implementation as follow-on, or hold until Claude Code seat runs its own version. Anthony has not yet committed to a path; thread remains open.
